title: Glyph: An Interpretability Engine for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery from Clinical Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.08922v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automated scientific discovery has the potential to advance understanding of disease mechanisms and accelerate identification of early disease markers. Manual data annotation is infeasible at population scale, motivating methods that automatically extract pre-defined phenotypes from multimodal and unstructured clinical data. Such pre-defined feature sets determine and limit which associations these approaches can discover. This limitation extends to agentic AI systems that use these tools to query population-scale data. In contrast, foundation models (FMs) trained on large volumes of clinical data can perform tasks beyond their training objectives. translated_title: Glyph：面向AI驱动的临床数据科学发现的可解释性引擎
translated_abstract: 自动化科学发现有潜力推进对疾病机制的理解，并加速早期疾病标志物的识别。人工数据标注在人群规模上不可行，这促使人们开发从多模态和非结构化临床数据中自动提取预定义表型的方法。然而，此类预定义特征集决定并限制了这些方法能够发现的关联。这一限制同样延伸到使用这些工具查询人群规模数据的智能体AI系统。相比之下，在大量临床数据上训练的基础模型（FM）能够执行超出其训练目标的任务，这表明其潜在嵌入可能代表着新颖或未被探索的特征，这些特征有望为疾病机制提供洞见，但此类潜在特征仍然难以解释。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了Glyph——一个自动化多阶段框架，用于提取特征……
tldr: 本文提出了Glyph，一个自动化多阶段可解释性框架，用于解释临床数据训练的基础模型的潜在特征，突破预定义表型的限制，从而实现AI驱动的疾病机制科学发现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Glyph, an automated multistage interpretability framework that decodes latent embeddings of clinical foundation models, enabling AI-driven scientific discovery of novel disease mechanisms beyond predefined feature sets.
